title: Post-hoc Study of Climate Microtargeting on Social Media Ads with LLMs: Thematic Insights and Fairness Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prediction disparities in targeted gender classifications of social media climate advertisements by comparing fairness metrics such as Demographic Parity, Equal Opportunity (True Positive Rate), and Predictive Equality (False Positive Rate) across male and female demographic groups.

Measuring disparities in model prediction accuracy and error rates across four age groups (young adults, early working age, late working age, and senior citizens) using Demographic Parity, Equal Opportunity, and Predictive Equality, supplemented by a qualitative error analysis to identify algorithmic reliance on age-related stereotypes.
